cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Truth or Loyalty
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between protecting the relationship and answering a dangerous question honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Mum's asking who broke her vase. Will you tell her, or keep your promise to your little brother?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's blaming the cleaner. I can't let that happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Clear the cleaner. Do you have to name me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's asked me directly whether you did it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then are you answering her, or keeping the promise I trusted you with?

mechanism: A invokes old sibling teaching to force its pupil to choose between honest disclosure and protecting the mentor relationship.
confusable: Not asking for an ordinary favor: A explicitly makes naming the culprit a test of loyalty after innocent alternatives fail.
comparison: Family promise against blame of cleaner versus professional partnership against client truth.
seedUse: D130 vase/Mum/cleaner/direct question; S05 older sibling instruction replaces conflicting little-brother prefix.
